_comment: Explicit list of STRONG CYP3A4 inhibitors (per FDA clinical-pharmacology classification). build_classmap.py pins the 'cyp3a4_strong_inhibitor' tag (in addition to 'cyp3a4_inhibitor') on each and ensures it is recognised. The stratified CYP3A4 mechanism rules fire ONLY on this strong tag — never on weak/moderate inhibitors — per clinician direction (Dr. Manoj Kumar Kurmana) to avoid alert fatigue while preserving the high-harm combinations. Moderate inhibitors (e.g. erythromycin, fluconazole, diltiazem, verapamil, grapefruit) are intentionally NOT included here.
